apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-dev
spec:
  versioningConfiguration:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
        sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

`stacks/bare/dev/logs-policy.yaml`

apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-access-dev
spec:
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject"
          ],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"
        }
      ]
    }
  userName: myapp-dev
```

`stacks/bare/prod/logs-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-prod
spec:
  versioningConfiguration:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
        sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

`stacks/bare/prod/logs-policy.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: AssumeRolePolicyDocument
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-access-prod
spec:
  inlinePolicies:
  - name: myapp-logs-access
    policyDocument: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:GetObject",
              "s3:PutObject"
            ],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-prod/*"
          }
        ]
      }
  roleName: myapp-prod
```

These manifests implement the requirements:
- New buckets named `myapp-logs-{env}`
- Versioning enabled via `versioningConfiguration.status: Enabled`
- Server-side encryption with AES256 configured
- All four public access block flags set to `true`
- Per-environment service principals (dev User, prod Role) granted `s3:GetObject` and `s3:PutObject` only on the new logs bucket
- Fully independent in each directory with no shared base
